title_sq: Prane Oxhakut, Tek Kompleksi Colombo Shitet Apartament 1+1 ideal per Investim !

title_en: Near the Chimney, in the Colombo Complex, 1+1 Apartment for sale, ideal for investment!
description_en: Apartment 1+1 for sale in the Colombo Complex, near the fireplace! The apartment is located on the 7th floor of a well-managed building, with an elevator. The orientation of the apartment is West, which allows natural light throughout the day. The apartment is organized by the living room connected to the kitchen corner and exit to the balcony, bedroom with separate wardrobe and exit to the balcony and spacious toilet. The apartment has regular mortgage documentation.
